name: Rooted Eyehole
description: Hold the hammer with the beak forward at chest height to threaten the foe while covering the body.

name: Smithflog
description: Jab the beak straight at a joint of the armor with the lead arm and a firm step.

name: Viselike Faceplate
description: Pull the hammer back so the beak drags across the target's guarding arm and spoils the guard.

name: Fleet Hammerblow
description: Step along the foe's flank until the beak lines up with a gap in the armor.

name: Rugged Peenside
description: Drive qi into the beak at the instant of the thrust so the point punches through a plate.

name: Gagging Forge
description: Hook the beak into the hole it made and wrench the plate open as the hammer comes back.

name: Savage Beakpick
description: Let the head fall in a long arc from above the shoulder so its own weight lands the blow.

name: Forgescorer
description: Step in until the arm is nearly straight and slam the hammer face down onto the shoulder.

name: Stubborn Spikeback
description: Lift the haft over the head in both hands to cover against a blow falling from above.

name: Forgehurdle
description: Drop the body weight into a deep step so the hammer enters the fight already falling.

name: Forgethwack
description: Catch the hammer as it rebounds off armor and lift it straight into the next blow.

name: Peenbite Thwack
description: Raise the hammer high and drive qi into the head so it falls and crushes shield and arm together.

name: Forgeflog
description: Press the head down onto a raised shield and keep qi flowing so the opponent's arm shakes and sinks.

name: Raw Drivehome
description: Tap the face of the hammer against the side of a helm so the sound rings in the wearer's ears.

name: Peenprop
description: Hook the beak under the rim of a helm and jerk the head down and sideways.

name: Dire Clawside
description: Reach over a bent opponent and knock the nape guard of the helm with the rear of the head.

name: Rooted Anvilback
description: Bow low and lift the haft so a high cut slides off the wood above the head.

name: Hammerface Carapace
description: Crouch behind the held hammer with the head tucked beside the face to cover the helm.

name: Slinking Anvilfall
description: Step beneath a wide swing so the helm is out of reach and the hammer is already near the foe.

name: Rough Hammerface
description: Strike a helm so qi in the head rings through the metal and rattles the skull inside.

name: Anvilbuckle
description: Follow a ringing blow with quick taps on the helm to blur the opponent's sight and hearing.

name: Clay Cheekplate
description: Shift the gauntleted grip along the haft so the wood covers the forearm against a cut.

name: Brass Anvilfall
description: Lean the armored shoulder into the foe and strike across the gap with the short haft.

name: Discord Eyehole
description: Push the haft flat against the opponent's chest and shove to throw them off their footing.

name: Anvilcurl
description: Advance with a heavy flat step that keeps the hammer low and the body square to the foe.

name: Dawnforge
description: Sweep the hammer level across a packed line so the head clips several men at the shoulder.

name: Brass Cheekplate
description: Drive qi into one heavy blow at the front man to shove him back into the rank behind.

name: Peenbite Scorer
description: Rise out of a guard with the head swinging up under the attacker's forearm.

name: Smithhasp
description: Lock both arms around the haft and hold it firm against a crashing blow.

name: Stalwart Beakpick
description: Parry with the haft then turn it over so the poll comes back at the attacker's ribs.

name: Smithscorer
description: Cover a low cut by dropping the head and counter at once with the rear spike at the thigh.

name: Gagging Anvilback
description: Catch a blade on the beak and turn the hammer so the weapon is dragged from line.

name: Scudding Clawside
description: Step clear of the exchange and raise the haft again into a ready guard.

name: Doughty Drivehome
description: Meet a cut with the haft and send a pulse of qi through it into an instant answering blow.

name: Peenbarrier
description: Flex the haft with a pulse of qi so a heavy blow bounces away and the hammer swings back.

name: Hammerneck Swat
description: Follow a held guard at once with a qi-fed crushing beat on the attacker's guarding hand.

name: Brawnpeen
description: Rap the edge of a plate with the hammer face to bend it away from the body beneath.

name: Vicious Peenside
description: Strike along a row of rivets so that the armor loosens at its fastenings.

name: Brawn Forge
description: Poke the spike into the armor joint at the elbow to jar the arm inside.

name: Guarding Hammerneck
description: Brace the legs and cover the neck with the haft against a cut from the side.

name: Brawn Tamp
description: Shuffle sideways to the unarmored side of the foe and set the hammer for a blow.

name: Brasspeen
description: Pour qi into the face at impact so the rivets of a plate burst and the armor opens.

name: Discord Tamp
description: Set the spike in a seam and wrench with qi in the arms until the plates part.

name: Vicious Hammerblow
description: Slap the broad flat face of the head against the target's side to stun without wounding.

name: Stern Faceplate
description: Prick the spike against a gap in the armor to draw the foe's guard out of line.

name: Lassoing Hammerface
description: Turn the haft end over end to change from face to spike and trap a guarding arm.

name: Sturdy Cheekplate
description: Hold the flat face of the head up before the visor to cover against a thrust.

name: Spikeback Scorer
description: Drive qi into the spike so it goes through a boiled-leather jerkin and into the flesh below.

name: Hammerblow Slap
description: Bring the broad face down with qi in the head to flatten a raised helm against the skull.

name: Brutal Peenbite
description: Tap the target's plate with a tiny pulse of qi to plant a shock that grows on the next blow.

name: Brawn Anvilfall
description: Slam the hammer in a short arc from close in so the shock lands before the foe can step back.

name: Keen Hammerneck
description: Knock the face against the breastplate so the ribs inside rattle against the steel.

name: Acrid Forge
description: Rap the steel twice in quick order so the second blow rides the shock of the first.

name: Sleetpeen
description: Brace the hammer head against the ground and lean on the haft to hold a push.

name: Beakpick Prop
description: Loosen the grip so the haft gives with a blow and turns it away from the body.

name: Rallying Eyehole
description: Rest the head lightly against the foe's plate and feel the shock settle to judge how it will break.

name: Tampthwack
description: Send a qi pulse through the haft so the blow's shock carries past the plate into the wearer.

name: Brawnsmith
description: Beat the plate in a steady rhythm with qi in the head so it flexes and the wearer tires.

name: Gleamsmith
description: Compress the shock into the spike so it breaks through steel and rattles the organs beneath.

name: Fierce Peenside
description: Slide the lower hand up the haft mid-swing to bring the head round faster and shorter.

name: Gripping Drivehome
description: Choke up on the haft and hook the beak behind the foe's knee to pull him down.

name: Anvilscorer
description: Hold the haft close to the head and jab the beak at the foe's face like a short spear.

name: Peenhasp
description: Flip the haft end over end to cover the lower body from a rising cut.

name: Brutal Tamp
description: Flick the wrist with a small pulse of qi so the head taps hard against a gripping hand.

name: Hungry Hammerblow
description: Gather qi in the wrists and let the head fall in a quick hard drop that cracks the foe's weapon arm.

name: Gagging Eyehole
description: Change grip suddenly in the clinch so the beak lands behind the target's elbow and tears the arm loose.

name: Peenbite Flog
description: Strike mail with the spike so the links tear and the cloth beneath is exposed.

name: Honed Clawside
description: Rap the overlapping scales with the face so they crack and shift out of place.

name: Static Anvilback
description: Chop the edge of the hammer face onto a plate to dent it inward against the wearer.

name: Doughty Tamp
description: Pound a padded coat with steady blows to bruise the body without cutting through the cloth.

name: Sprigpeen
description: Brace the haft against the hip and turn the body to cover the side from a blade.

name: Rillpeen
description: Step on a slant across open ground to reach the foe's weaker armored side.

name: Ember Cheekplate
description: Drive a qi-fed blow into mail so the links crush into the padding and the flesh behind it.

name: Savage Hammerneck
description: Hook the beak under a scale with a qi thrust so it splits the row and stabs through.
